article.title: Russian attacks on Ukraine kill six overnight: authorities
article.summary: The capital has come under increased attack in recent weeks as winter approaches, with air raid sirens wailing nearly constantly to warn of incoming Russian strikes.

article.title: Three children's bodies recovered from Pryluky rubble as death toll rises to nine, with 38 injured
article.summary: In Pryluky, Chernihiv region, the death toll from the Russian strike has risen to nine; the bodies of three children were recovered from the rubble.

article.title: Massive Russian Attack Kills At Least 18, Devastates Pryluky Apartment Block
article.summary: Russia launched a massive overnight missile and drone attack across Ukraine, killing at least 18 people. Strikes severely damaged a 5-story apartment building in the northeastern city of Pryluky and caused extensive damage to homes and infrastructure in Kremenchuk in the central Poltava region.

article.summary: Heavy casualties in Ukraine after Russian strikes

article.title: Russian missile strike on apartment building in Ukraine kills 14, including four children. Zelensky calls it the Russian army’s ‘birthday gift’ to Putin.
article.summary: Russia’s military carried out a combined missile and drone attack overnight and into the morning, striking several regions of Ukraine.

article.title: Russian Attack Leaves Unexploded Ballistic Missile Among Homes in Kyiv, Hits Film Studio and Bird Center
article.summary: An unexploded Russian ballistic missile was found among residential buildings in Kyiv, prompting a complex demining operation. The overnight attack also damaged the Dovzhenko Film Studio, destroyed an ATL Autoservice warehouse, and wiped out a bird rehabilitation center in the Kyiv region.

article.title: Families with children and police veteran: what is known about those killed in Russian strike on Pryluky
article.summary: Russian forces attacked Pryluky in Chernihiv Oblast with six missiles on the morning of 7 October. One of the missiles hit a five-storey apartment building, destroying two sections. So far, 16 people are known to have been killed and 55 injured. Rescue workers are still clearing the rubble.

article.title: Missile War Monitor: Russian missile barrage kills at least 11 in Ukraine, hits Pryluky apartment block
article.summary: bne IntelliNewsRussia's missile and drone attack on October 7 killed at least 11 people across Ukraine, at least five of them in an apartment block in Pryluky.

article.title: Russian strikes on Ukrainian cities kill at least 24 in a major attack that Kyiv saw coming
article.summary: Despite knowing about the looming attack, Ukraine couldn’t completely fend it off. The deaths and damage highlight Ukraine’s struggle to counter Russia’s ballistic missiles and new jet-powered drones.

article.title: Russia launches one of largest attacks on Ukraine, killing at least 11 as energy infrastructure targeted
article.summary: Russia launched a large-scale missile and drone attack across Ukraine overnight into 7 October, killing at least 11 people and injuring more than 30.

article.title: Russian missile attack on Pryluky: Death toll rises to 14, 50 injured
article.summary: The death toll from the Russian missile attack on Pryluky, Chernihiv region, on October 7 has risen to 14, including four children.

article.title: 3 One-Year-Old Boys Among 18 Killed in Russian Strike on Pryluky – Zelensky
article.summary: Three one-year-old boys were among 18 people killed in a Russian missile strike on a residential building in Pryluky, northern Ukraine. The attack was part of a massive overnight barrage that killed at least 24 people nationwide, including four children, and injured dozens more.

article.title: Russian strike on apartment building in Pryluky: Death toll rises to 16, 55 injured
article.summary: The death toll from a Russian missile attack on Pryluky, Chernihiv region, on October 7 has risen to 16, including four children.

article.title: Number of injured in Kremenchuk rises to 47 after Russian attack, two people killed
article.summary: Two people were killed and the number of injured has risen to 47, including two children, following a Russian attack on Kremenchuk on 7 October.

article.title: Russian strikes on Ukrainian cities kill at least 21 in a major attack that Kyiv saw coming
article.summary: Russian missiles and drones pounded Kyiv and a dozen other Ukrainian regions overnight into Wednesday, killing at least 21 civilians, including four children, and wounding around 60 in Moscow’s latest devastating barrage, Ukrainian officials said.

article.title: Ukrainian forces hit two oil facilities, training range in Russia – Zelensky
article.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said that Ukraine's Defense Forces struck four targets that help Russia finance and wage its war, including two oil facilities and a training range in three Russian regions.

article.title: Heavy casualties in Ukraine after Russian strikes
article.summary: At least 15 people were killed in Russian strikes across Ukraine on Oct. 7, the authorities said, including nine when a missile destroyed an apartment block in the north of the country.

article.title: Zelensky on Russian attack: Infrastructure in Kyiv and 12 regions hit, energy sector key target
article.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said that during the latest air attack, Russian forces used 70 missiles, many of them ballistic ones, as well as Shahed drones, with energy infrastructure being a key target. Infrastructure in Kyiv and 12 regions came under attack.

article.title: Russian missile and drone strikes across Ukraine kill six and injure more than 20
article.summary: Russian forces attacked Ukraine overnight on October 7 with missiles, including ballistic missiles, and drones.

article.title: Zelensky calls on world to increase pressure on Russia
article.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that Russia's continued missile strikes against Ukraine represent a deliberate choice to use terror and called on international partners to increase pressure on Moscow and strengthen defense support for Ukraine.

article.title: Russia’s Birthday ‘Gift’ to Putin: 70 Missiles Strike Ukraine, Hitting Homes and Killing Civilians
article.summary: Russia launched 70 missiles and attack drones across Ukraine on Vladimir Putin’s birthday, targeting Kyiv and 12 regions. At least 14 people, including four children, were killed in a destroyed apartment building in Pryluky, while the nationwide death toll reached at least 20.

article.title: Russian missile strike on Pryluky kills four, injures 20
article.summary: The death toll from a Russian strike on an apartment building in Pryluky, Chernihiv region, has risen to four.

article.title: Death toll from Russian missile strike on Pryluky rises to five, 25 injured
article.summary: The death toll from a Russian strike on an apartment building in Pryluky, Chernihiv region, has risen to five.

article.title: Unexploded ballistic missile being neutralized in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district
article.summary: Police and the State Emergency Service are carrying out a complex operation to neutralize an unexploded ballistic missile found among residential buildings in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district.

article.title: Massive attack: Air defenses neutralize 117 drones, five ballistic missiles, 39 cruise missiles
article.summary: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized five ballistic missiles, 39 cruise missiles and 117 drones used by Russian forces to attack Ukraine since the evening of October 6.

article.title: Russian missile hits apartment block in Pryluky, casualties reported
article.summary: A Russian strike damaged an apartment block in Pryluky, Chernihiv region, killing and injuring civilians.

article.title: Russian missile strike in Ukraine's capital kills at least 2

article.title: Zelensky condemns 'vile' large-scale Russian attacks that killed 24
article.summary: Rescue workers are continuing a search for residents after an apartment building in Pryluky was destroyed.

article.summary: Two people were killed and seven others injured in a Russian attack on Kremenchuk, Poltava region, according to preliminary reports.

article.title: Four sleeping children dead in Ukraine, as Russian strikes kill at least 24 people
article.summary: Three of the 18 victims of a strike in Pryluky were just 12 months old, while another was aged eight.

article.title: Russia Missile Blasts Ukraine Apartment Block, Killing At Least 18
article.summary: Russian missile and drone strikes pounded Ukraine on Russian leader Vladimir Putin's birthday, leaving dozens of people dead or injured in one of "the most vile" attacks in recent times, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.

article.title: Death toll from Russian strike in Pryluky rises to 19, including five children – photos
article.summary: The death toll from the 7 October Russian missile strike on a residential building in Pryluky, Chernihiv Oblast, has risen to 19, including five children, with 55 people injured.

article.title: Missile attack on Kremenchuk: Two killed, injury toll rises to 41
article.summary: In Kremenchuk, Poltava region, 41 people were injured as a result of an enemy attack, and two deaths have been reported.

article.title: 5 Ballistic Missiles, 117 Drones: Ukraine Repels Massive Russian Overnight Attack
article.summary: Ukraine said its forces intercepted or suppressed 161 Russian targets, including five ballistic missiles, 39 cruise missiles, and 117 drones. The attack struck 18 locations, while debris from intercepted targets fell at five sites.
